# Nails & Lashes by Tam & Landon

> Nail & lash studio based in Georgetown, Texas. Gel and acrylic sets, jeweled nail art, pedicures, lashes and permanent brows from Tam and Landon, in their own studio on W University Ave in Georgetown.

- Phone: (325) 280-1552
- Based in: Georgetown, TX
- Nearby areas: Georgetown, Round Rock, Leander, Liberty Hill, Jarrell, Hutto
- Google rating: 4.7 from 15 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/nails-and-lashes-by-tam-and-landon/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/nails-and-lashes-by-tam-and-landon/book.html

## Services
- Gel manicures: Glossy gel color in any shade you bring in, from sporty neutrals to lavender with a holo glitter accent.
- Acrylic & full sets: Long coffin, almond or stiletto sets with clean shaping and smooth ombre.
- Nail art & rhinestones: Hand-placed crystals, crosses, leaves and little details that make a set yours.
- Seasonal sets: Holiday reds, snowflakes, candy canes, fall glitter: a fresh set for every season.
- Pedicures: Pedicures in the red spa chairs under the butterfly wall, on their own or with a manicure.
- Lashes & permanent brows: Lash extensions, lifts and tints, plus permanent eyebrows by Tam, so you wake up done.

## About
Tam and Landon are a couple who do nails, and they do them together. For years their clients knew them at another salon. When they opened a place of their own, in Room 4 of Suite 105 at 940 W University Ave, a lot of those clients followed them there. Reviewers mention the same few things: excellent work every time, friendliness, punctuality and flexible scheduling. Landon does the neutral and sporty sets regulars swear by, and Tam does permanent eyebrows on top of nails. Every set gets photographed on the same fluffy white backdrop, from jeweled almonds to holiday candy canes, and the newest ones go up on Instagram at @tam_landon_2528. Inside the studio: a wall of polish, red spa chairs and a wall of paper butterflies.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 a.m. to 7 p.m. Closed Sundays. Holiday hours may differ, so call or text to check.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: Room 4 in Suite 105 at 940 W University Ave, Georgetown, TX 78626, next to Austin Regional Clinic. Parking is free.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Call or text (325) 280-1552, or book online through Tam & Landon's Vagaro page. It's a two-person studio, so booking ahead gets you the time you want.
- Q: Do you do lashes and brows too?
  A: Yes. Lash extensions, lash lifts and tints, and permanent eyebrows by Tam.
- Q: Can you copy a design I saw online?
  A: Bring a photo. Rhinestones, glitter fades, ombre and seasonal art are all regular requests.
- Q: What if I need to cancel?
  A: Please give 48 hours notice. Cash, debit and major cards (Visa, Mastercard, Discover, Amex) are accepted.
